proposed_native_export: Opt-in reporting after original native solve; basis-probe native ufield0a in both channels and restore uind/uinp exactly. Export A=diag(1/alpha)-T, Ed=udir/alpha, Ep=udirp/alpha, original u/v, ordered site/type/coordinate/alpha data and units at17digits.
required_scope: Original vacuum MUTUAL double-loop route; reject unsupported bounds/Ewald/solvent/EXCHPOL/CHGPEN/alternative solvers and inactive or zero-alpha sites.
Respect native poli=max(polmin,polarity), preferably reject alphas below the native floor for this declared scope.
Ed/Ep include any native external field; reject such fields for a zero-field export or record and separate their contribution.
Preserve native u/v and output separate numbered snapshots for the two analyze-EM solves.
qualification: Symmetry and equality of both mutual channel operators.
Full-precision native u/v and residuals Au-Ed, Av-Ep.
Native polarization energy -K/2*u^T*Ep and unchanged overall analysis outputs.
Independent linear solve and the already admitted centered uniform-field response, retaining solver/output precision limitations.
finite_screen_use: With fixed snapshots, solve (A+H)u=Ed+h and (A+H)v=Ep+h, check total matrix positivity, and compare energy corrections Ucandidate-Ubaseline, full conjugate dipole from permanent+half(u+v), and uniform susceptibility. Use total baseline plus polarization correction rather than replacing unrelated energy terms.
limitation: Snapshots do not provide dA/dR,dEd/dR,dEp/dR. They support finite fixed-geometry response/energy screening, not force qualification or a claim of passing the original25 gates. Full matrix positivity and one-mode leverage do not establish physical accuracy.
